review_scope: Independent actual visual inspection of the final local image; emphasis on architectural appearance, visible occupied storeys, main footprint scale and object relationships. Not a complete pixel/ground-geometry re-audit.
summary_zh: 第三次局部生成保留九层塔身和三层南门；较V3的出檐、收分、承托层次、门窗与塔刹表现明显改善。主塔基座恢复到接近V3的主要尺度与位置，第一张严重放大的问题已纠正。后殿仍略偏左、偏低；完整基址与全景未通过。可选为本轮形制改定图，不可直接回嵌或替换首页。

tower.count_method: Bottom entrance storey plus eight separate upper wall/column/window bands; roofs, bracket zones, rear hall and finial excluded.
tower.window_role: Approximate locations of visible bodies to make the visual count reproducible; not recovered floor heights or measured floor boundaries.

south_gate.count_method: Ground entrance body plus two upper occupied body bands. Three roof strips alone are not used as proof.

appearance_findings_zh: 各层出檐更深，屋面坡度较缓，屋檐、斗栱承托与柱身的层次更清楚；不再主要依靠长条墙身堆叠。
下部较宽、上部渐收，底层入口和门窗虚实得到明确表达，九层之间仍能辨认实际墙身。
木色、浅色墙面、灰瓦和檐下阴影形成较自然的材质与空间关系。
塔刹由旧版光杆改为有分节、盘状构件及顶部装置的轮廓，仍位于塔身中轴，不计作第十层。
改定后仍是一幅基于参照的艺术立面方案；图像中具体斗栱、窗格、塔刹构件不因此成为永宁寺出土形制。

relationship_checks.source_homography_check_basis: Same frozen source/audit used as comparison; this review does not fit a transform to the generated image.

major_geometry_observations.method: Approximate manual reading of the full native-size image; no fitted registration, new source geometry, complex overlay or complete per-edge pixel audit. Approximate V4 limits have about ±4px reading uncertainty.

tower_plinth.finding: Main scale and position are again close to V3; the first V4 attempt’s much broader and lower platform is no longer present. This is not complete correspondence to the frozen source ring.

rear_hall.finding: Still shifted somewhat left and down relative to V3: left edge about20–25px farther left and lower visible front edge about10–15px lower. Central footprint remains hidden behind tower.

south_gate.finding: Three-storey gate and its overall position/size remain visually close to V3; no obvious new large displacement. Earlier source-footprint errors are not presumed repaired.

reference_verification_scope.historical_photo_research: Handled separately in the parent research/source notes; this visual reviewer did not independently redo source authentication.
reference_verification_scope.this_review_certifies: Observed improvement of form and material expression plus retained visible storey counts, not historical exactness.

remaining_limits_zh: 后殿仍略偏左、偏低，不能写成基址均已恢复。
主塔基本尺度回到V3附近不等于所有角点、侧缘和遮挡段均吻合冻结来源。
本次没有重新核定实体寺墙、全部基脚和完整全景。
旧V3的已知几何欠缺未被本轮外观改定自动消除。
新外观不构成考古立面复原或首页替换批准。
